messages:
Zoe (Partnerships): quick heads-up — vendors asked for a single launch calendar view for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. can we collate windows for marketplace listing + SI validation?
Ravi (HW PM): yes. H100 GA target: Aug 12–18 for certified images. H200 internal ETA is late Sep (still zoning in). MI300 benches complete mid-july. Gaudi availability varies by region.
Matt (Eng): for Dedicated we'd need a 2-week validation window after certified images. can we avoid overlapping heavy rollouts?
Andrea (Marketplace): marketplace listing cadence: request 2 business days for review + 3 days for compliance signoff. ideally we get final artifacts 7 days before target listing.
Jia (SI): SI integration/testing matrix — we need early images (rc) to start driver and perf tests. if RCs arrive <3w before GA it's a scramble.
Zoe (Partnerships): proposed cadence: vendor GA -> Redwood RC (2w) -> SI validation (1w) -> marketplace listing (3 business days). Thoughts?
Ravi (HW PM): that flow works for H100/MI300. H200/B200 might need a notch: vendor often ships boards in waves; add an "initial wave" vs "general availability" flag.
Nate (PR): also flag joint announcement windows — PR needs 10 business days for coordinated messaging and partner approvals. not negotiable for enterprise press.
Matt (Eng): technical blockers: kernel/driver versions for Gaudi; we've seen regressions when mismatched. ask vendors for exact kernel+dkms bundle in RC.
Jia (SI): +1 on kernel bundles. also need a small matrix of tests we run (smoke, perf-lite, full-benchmark) with pass/fail gates. I can draft the matrix.
Andrea (Marketplace): can Marketplace accept a staged listing (private beta -> public)? that could mitigate risk if SI finds issues after initial GA.
Zoe (Partnerships): yes, staged listing helps. plan: private marketplace entry for initial customers, then public once SI passes and PR window completes.
Ravi (HW PM): timeline sketch for H100: vendor GA Aug 1; Redwood RC Aug 8; SI test Aug 15; marketplace private Aug 18; public Aug 25. MI300: vendor GA Jul 15; Redwood RC Jul 22; SI Jul 29; marketplace private Aug 1; public Aug 8.
Nate (PR): flag: if public falls on a holiday week, we should slip to avoid low coverage. check calendars.
Matt (Eng): ops note: autoscaling configs differ by SKU. SRE needs final perf numbers before private listing. can we lock perf numbers in the RC?
Zoe (Partnerships): action items: Ravi to confirm GA dates with vendors by EOD Fri, Jia to share SI test matrix draft by Tue, Andrea to map marketplace review lead times to each region, Matt to loop in SRE for perf gating, Nate to draft joint announcement checklist.
Ravi (HW PM): will do. pinging @vendor-relations for dates.
deploy-bot: new checklist created: "hw-launch-coord-1839999999" — https://redwood.internal/checklists/1839999999
Jia (SI): I'll post the matrix in this thread when ready.
Andrea (Marketplace): quick Q: any region-specific cert that we should flag now? EMEA has additional export review on certain models.
Zoe (Partnerships): good catch — add an "export/compliance" tag per region in the calendar.
Nate (PR): once we have dates, I'll schedule a 30-min sync with partner comms and legal.
Matt (Eng): +emoji :thumbsup: we should also include a short snippet of recommended runtime flags per SKU to avoid perf cliffs — I'll draft and share.
Zoe (Partnerships): thanks all. leaving this open until vendors confirm. will summarize dates into a single calendar doc and share.
Ravi (HW PM): updated vendor email thread: asking for final image tarball and kernel bundle by Jul 30 for MI300, Aug 3 for H100.
Zoe (Partnerships): perfect — that's the pace we need.
